maria: Heads-up: Starting sequenced rollout for service-infer v2.14 across US/EU/APAC. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Window 01:30-03:30 UTC. Need quick capacity signoff + smoke after each slice. pin config: `region_pin: true`, version: `v2.14`.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout v2.14 -> US (slice 1/3). Start in 5m. Change window: 01:35 UTC. Canary 10% traffic for 10m.
liam: On it. Running quota/GPUs check now.
liam: GPU pool us-west-1: free_gpus=42, expected_need=30. Autoscale headroom 12 nodes. I'll run perf smoke.
priya: @liam thanks. Can you watch p95 and OOMs? set alert: if p95>400ms or OOMs>2 in 5m -> abort.
ops-oncall: Ops alert thresholds set. Rollback playbook pinned: `ops/rollbacks/v2.14.md`
jason: runbook check: KV-cache warmup enabled, batching target 64 tokens, explicit quant profile `q4_0_s`.
maya: FYI: EU capacity still tight tonight, we should reserve extra burst in EU if US shows degraded perf.
liam: Smoke results: US canary 10% ok. p50=85ms, p95=320ms, gpu mem stable. No errors in logs. Proceeding to ramp to 50%.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary passed. Ramping to 50% over 3m.
maria: Confirming: EU holdpoint at 01:50 UTC. @priya can you validate quotas and AMI compatibility? If EU quotas < required -> we'll pin EU to v2.12 and continue APAC.
priya: Checked EU quotas: gpu_free=8, expected=18 -> insufficient. Recommend pinning EU to v2.12 and opening support ticket to request extra capacity. Will post ticket #INC-4521.
maya: Agree with pin. Also APAC region has new instance types but drivers not validated. Need to skip APAC until we verify.
maria: Decision: Pin EU to v2.12 for now. Continue APAC blocked. Rolling US to full traffic. Documenting in release notes and ops channel. If US drops p95>450ms for 2 consecutive minutes -> auto-rollback to v2.13.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: US ramp to 100% complete. version pinned: v2.14.
liam: Monitoring dashboards: CPU steady, p95=340ms. Logging will keep retention 24h for rollout. I'll keep watch for 30m.
priya: Ticket created INC-4521 with cloud quota. ETA 6h. Adding note to release: EU pinned pending quota.
jason: Added release note: 'v2.14 rolled to US, EU pinned v2.12 pending quota, APAC deferred - drivers validation required.'
maria: Thanks team. Followups: postmortem if any rollback. I'll update the release checklist and close this thread after 1h stable.
